value.title: Ship it: CI, cross-platform release, install
value.summary: GitHub Actions gate on main, release-please semver releases with all-platform binaries, curl installer, Dependabot. PRD reqs 46-48.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: "Turn the proven build substrate into pipelines (Jordan agreements 2026-08-26): a Linux gate on every main push (checks + tests with pgvector service, fake provider, no endpoints/secrets); release-please rolling release PR (conventional commits now binding) cut on merge; release builds = Linux+Windows in the plan-002 build container + mac BUILT on a macOS runner but never gated (Windows produced-not-run, both deferred-validation stances recorded honestly in release notes); a curl installer (+ PowerShell twin) pulling the latest GitHub Release; Dependabot on cargo+actions. gh CLI is authed for watching runs."

sections.name: goals
value: Every main push proves the tree on Linux exactly as harness checks does locally, incl. store tests against a pgvector service container.
Merging the release PR produces a semver GitHub Release carrying mac(arm64+x64)/linux(arm64+x64, gnu+musl)/windows(x64) binaries named by target triple.
One-line install works on mac and linux from the README (windows script present, validated later).

sections.name: non_goals
value: Running/validating windows binaries (deferred; procedure documented in ox's strategy doc).
Gating on macOS runners (mac builds release-only; Linux is the only checking platform).
PR-based workflows/branch protection (we work on main; revisit at first PR).
Publishing to crates.io/homebrew/winget (later; GitHub Releases only).

value.claim: A workflow on every main push runs fmt/clippy -D warnings/tests/arch-drift on Linux with a pgvector service; observed green on a real push via gh run watch.
release-please maintains a rolling release PR from conventional commits; merging it tags semver and publishes a GitHub Release.

The Release carries 7 binaries (darwin arm64+x64; linux arm64+x64 gnu+musl... per ox's matrix; windows x64 gnu .exe) named by target triple, built via the plan-002 container (mac native on macos runner).
`curl -fsSL <raw url>/install.sh | sh` installs the right binary on mac and linux, verified live on this machine; install.ps1 exists (unvalidated, stated).
Dependabot config live for cargo + github-actions; first scan observed.

value.title: Workflows, release, install
value.brief: CI gate first (watch it green on main), then release machinery, then installer + dependabot.

value.question: Gate scope?
value.answer: Every main push now; PR gating when PRs begin (Jordan). Linux only checks; mac builds release-only unvalidated; windows produced-not-run.

value.question: Release cadence?
value.answer: release-please rolling PR, merged on Jordan's word.

value.question: Secrets?
value.answer: None: tier system keeps CI endpoint-free; GITHUB_TOKEN only.

value.notes: every dw is an observed real run via gh

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: CI runs plain cargo test ONLY - keyed/slow tiers stay out; no provider secrets exist in Actions.
Toolchain comes from rust-toolchain.toml - never a hardcoded version in workflows.
Release notes state deferred-validation honestly (mac unvalidated-by-CI, windows unexecuted).
Shared-tree commit discipline unchanged; workflows land as normal scoped commits.
